behavior: USB rows show bounded USB product/model and manufacturer, accessory-mode hint, and secondary USB IDs. Missing names are explicit. Labels never authorize Connect or pairing.

coverage.method: Fresh instrumented target; unchanged Rust source hashes checked before importing native LCOV; repository per-function gate applied to changed functions plus adjacent short decoder. No lines excluded.

complexity.scope: All functions in changed Rust files, including tests. Supplementary external native scan main: 2.

native_observation.method: Read-only Scan::start/finish using existing blent-usb-io --list; no device opens, claims, USB control transfers, pairing, or media capture.

ownership.owner: Existing admitted Task owns the descriptor batch; reaper retains admission until native completion and join on cancellation/caller loss.
ownership.bounds: At most 512 candidates; each name <=256 UTF-8 bytes; each attribute read <=258 bytes; at most one metadata worker per scan; cancelled workers remain charged to the existing global work-admission pool.
ownership.handoff: Worker owns candidates and files; oneshot transfers result only after worker join; cancelled receiver drops result; snapshot replacement releases old strings through existing snapshot ownership.
ownership.invariants: No raw pointers or borrowed names escape; descriptor hints cannot change target/revision authority; native files close before worker completion; no release of worker admission based solely on timeout.
ownership.cleanup_assumption: A running filesystem syscall must eventually return for eventual cleanup. If it does not, worker and admission remain retained. Kernel/device safety is not proved by hosted tests.
ownership.tests: Permanent blocked FIFO cancellation, unplug during read, successful join, missing/invalid/oversized descriptors, UTF-8 and control-character bounds.

limits: Linux implementation and rendering validated; native Windows GUI evidence remains T1271 and ADB-free USB remains unsupported there.
The USB-reported manufacturer can differ from the retail brand; custom Android device nicknames are not exposed by these descriptors.
Existing installed app was not replaced; local GUI and broker binaries rebuilt together.
